purpose: Size the Leung_DFCFC2_Pin_3 amplifier using the permitted parameters. Meet all eight fixed nominal DC, AC, and transient requirements within 30 evaluations. The joint requirements are project-defined for this released circuit adaptation.

design_context.circuit_description: Rearranged damping-factor-control network with extra PMOS gm4 near first-stage output. C1 device uses CAPACITOR_0; C2 device uses CAPACITOR_1. Device instance number is not parameter index. Original Fig.7 correspondence reviewed. Leung variants must share a source-family split; DFC high-impedance DC node robustness is not established by nominal sizing.
